Name: Hope's Secret Springs Cave
Author: HopeWasHere
Description:
This is just a simple map cave mod that adds a secret hot springs under your farm cave.

For support for this mod, or to see other mods I've made, head to the official support thread: [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/hopes-mods.130359/#post-3115777]http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/hopes-mods.130359/#post-3115777[/url]

Credits are in the Read Me

Edit 5/22: Fixed the map spawn, sorry I didn't notice it earlier. This should fix the character not being able to enter the cave correctly. Please head to the official support thread for questions or troubleshooting.
